from rhid_attendance_adjustments import SharePointRhidAttendanceAdjustmentStore, validate_adjustment_against_rhid

class Bridge:
    def portal_rhid_attendance_report(
        self, identity: dict, selected_date, *, allowed_emails: set[str],
    ) -> dict:
        """Consulta RHID e acrescenta os ajustes manuais sem alterar a origem."""
        raw_date = str(selected_date or "").strip()
        try:
            on_date = date.fromisoformat(raw_date)
        except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise ValueError("Data inválida para o relatório RHID.") from exc
        if on_date.isoformat() != raw_date:
            raise ValueError("Data inválida para o relatório RHID.")

        with self.lock:
            key, state = self._portal_state(identity)
            self.portal_owners.authorize(
                key, identity, state_exists=bool(state), bind=bool(state),
                allowed_emails=allowed_emails,
            )

        source_rows = self.engine.sharepoint.get_rhid_attendance_report(on_date)
        pending_rows = self.engine.sharepoint.get_pending_attendance(on_date)
        person_keys_by_name = {}
        for row in source_rows:
            if isinstance(row, dict):
                name = normalize_text(str(row.get("NOME_COLABORADOR") or ""))
                person_key = str(row.get("ID_PESSOA_RHID") or row.get("Id") or "").strip()
                if name and person_key:
                    person_keys_by_name.setdefault(name, set()).add(person_key)
        pending_by_name = {}
        for row in pending_rows:
            if not isinstance(row, dict):
                continue
            name = normalize_text(str(row.get("FORNECEDOR") or ""))
            identifier = str(row.get("Id") or "").strip()
            if (name and re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*", identifier)
                and str(row.get("DATA") or "")[:10] == on_date.isoformat()
                and normalize_text(str(row.get("PRESENCA") or "")) == "pendente"):
                pending_by_name.setdefault(name, []).append(identifier)
        fields = (
            "ID_PESSOA_RHID",
            "DATA_REFERENCIA",
            "NOME_COLABORADOR",
            "BATIDAS_RHID",
            "MINUTOS_TRABALHADOS",
            "STATUS_RHID",
            "COLETADO_EM",
            "ORIGEM_ULTIMA_ALTERACAO",
        )
        adjustment_store = getattr(self, "rhid_attendance_adjustments", None)
        adjustments = adjustment_store.latest_for_day(on_date) if adjustment_store is not None else {}
        rows = []
        for row in source_rows:
            if not isinstance(row, dict):
                continue
            item_id = row.get("Id", row.get("ID"))
            rhid_id = str(row.get("ID_PESSOA_RHID") or "").strip()
            person_key = f"rhid:{rhid_id}" if rhid_id else f"id:{item_id}"
            item = {"Id": item_id, **{field: row.get(field) for field in fields}}
            name = normalize_text(str(row.get("NOME_COLABORADOR") or ""))
            item["pendingPresenceIds"] = pending_by_name.get(name, []) if len(person_keys_by_name.get(name, ())) == 1 else []
            if person_key in adjustments:
                item["ADMIN_AJUSTES"] = adjustments[person_key]
            rows.append(item)
        return {
            "status": "processed",
            "messages": [],
            "attendanceReport": {"date": on_date.isoformat(), "rows": rows},
        }

class Handler:
    def handle(self, action, body, identity):
        if True:
            if action == "other":
                pass
            else:
                if action == "other2":
                    pass
                elif action == "rhid_attendance_report":
                    result = self.bridge.portal_rhid_attendance_report(
                        identity,
                        body.get("date"),
                        allowed_emails=self.portal_authenticator.allowed_emails,
                    )
